entries.0b17ef37a2171f83: This category covers peripherals such as network equipment and storage and memory products, and accessories for smartphones, tablets and related devices. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥31,291 million.
entries.388f98893038bd37: This category covers rugged tablets and NAS for businesses, storage for industrial equipment, broadcast and reception-related equipment and related construction work, and design, construction, operation and maintenance services for IT infrastructure. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥42,909 million, growing significantly, driven by the new consolidation of Nihon Antenna and other factors.
entries.4f085f085d46f82e: This segment covers beauty and personal appliances such as hair dryers under the TESCOM brand, and home accessories such as electric air dusters. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥13,471 million.
entries.6e7f5ee95a9ac900: An Osaka-based manufacturer that develops, manufactures and sells personal computer peripherals, digital devices and home appliance-related products.
entries.7a92b4f2c9a04a9c: This is the sole reportable segment of the company's group, engaging in the development, manufacture and sale of PC, digital device and home appliance-related products, and related services. In addition to the company's ELECOM brand, consolidated subsidiary Logitec INA Solutions develops products under the Logitec brand, Hagiwara Solutions under the HAGIWARA Solutions and JDS brands, DX Antenna under the DX Antenna brand, and Tescom Denki under the Tescom brand. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥132,132 million, accounting for all of consolidated revenue. In November 2025, Nihon Antenna Co., Ltd. joined as a wholly owned subsidiary through a share exchange.
entries.9e714a011722d456: This segment covers products and services not included in the above segments. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,463 million.
entries.de7dc0ea843f3f83: This category covers input devices such as keyboards and mice, power-related products such as mobile batteries, AC chargers and power strips, docking stations and others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥42,996 million. Sales of keyboards, power strips and docking stations expanded amid policy demand such as the next-generation GIGA School Initiative and demand for PC replacements.
